7449.title: HOME fixture escapes to system npm
7449.rootCauseOneLine: The HOME test fixture omits npm while returning an artifact 404, allowing the installer registry fallback to resolve host npm.

prReviews.topFinding: A fixture-local npm stub addresses the verified escape; the PR branch was not executed.

7449.proposedFix: Stub npm in the HOME fixture so registry fallback fails deterministically without using host npm. Existing PR #7450 already proposes this change.
7449.caveats: Both clean runs use an inert system-npm surrogate. Actual registry traffic, Fedora timings, CI history, and load-induced timeouts were not repeated. Reproduction script is inline under the reports repository publication policy.
